# stingray
> stingray is a performance-driven digital advertising agency based in Dbayeh, Lebanon, operating across MENA and the GCC. Services: paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google), SEO and GEO, e-commerce growth, landing pages and conversion funnels. stingray is the advertising arm of Swot Creative Hub (swottm.com), a creative and digital agency operating between Beirut and Doha.

## Ventures
- stingray taste (https://taste.stingray-ads.com/): custom landing pages and digital solutions for restaurants, cafés, lounges, cloud kitchens and catering · designed from scratch, never templates · live in 5 days · booking integrations, Meta pixel and conversion tracking built in.

## Key facts
- Location: Dbayeh, Waterfront City, Lebanon
- Regions served: Lebanon, Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman
- Parent: Swot Creative Hub (swottm.com)
- Contact: via stingray-ads.com
